finished: THAT IS THE GAME. BACK TO THE CLUB.

steps.why: The red ring is you. The arrow is over whoever has the puck.

steps.say: HOLD {shoot} TO WIND UP, LET GO TO FIRE
steps.why: The longer the wind-up, the harder the shot. Point the stick at a corner of the net.

steps.say: TAP {pass}: IT GOES TO THE DIAMOND
steps.why: The diamond is under the team-mate your pass would go to.
Time runs slow while your pass is on its way, and the gold ring is round the man it is going to. A one-timer beats the goalie far more often than a shot off the carry.

steps.say: GET IN FRONT OF HIM AND TAP {check}
steps.why: A poke takes the puck from in front or beside him, inside the circle, never from behind.

steps.say: HOLD {check}, LET GO AS YOU REACH HIM
steps.why: A body check knocks him off the puck. Come in fast and it puts him on the ice.

second.finished: THOSE ARE THE REST OF THE MOVES. BACK TO THE CLUB.

steps.say: WITH THE PUCK, PRESS {switch}: A DEKE
steps.why: A deke goes round the nearest defender, and the check he is throwing misses. Use it as he reaches you.

steps.say: HOLD {shoot}, THEN TAP {pass} BEFORE YOU LET GO
steps.why: A fake: the shot is called off and the goalie is stuck for a moment. Shoot again at once.

steps.say: TAP {pass}, THEN TAP {pass} AGAIN WHILE IT IS ON ITS WAY
steps.why: A give and go: you keep your man, skate for the net, and the puck comes back to you.

steps.say: HOLD {pass} UNTIL THE BAR IS FULL, THEN LET GO
steps.why: A saucer pass: it flies over the sticks in its way, so a covered lane is open to it. It is slower, and nobody can touch it until it lands.

steps.say: AWAY FROM THE PUCK, HOLD {check}: DOWN TO BLOCK
steps.why: Down on one knee between the shooter and the net you stop his shot. You can only shuffle while you are down.
